about: Rough patches (dungeon/life/rough_patches.py): the companion's first text after the user found out they had been seeing someone behind the user's back (Their own love life, dungeon/life/love_life.py). Used when the reply is not model-written; picked by seeded dice. Era-neutral, no gendered words.
